text:
Stocks have been bleeding the past 4 weeks, but S&P down just 4.5%.  Yet, sentiment is well past the levels where I would want to buy the dip, in a bull market.  This is classic bull market, sentiment resets and price remains well supported.

We had a similar cycle leading up to the Stocks 4yr cycle in 2021. 

With many AI names already punished, I think stocks are not going to see much more of a decline here.
